_about: Setup merges the blocks the user chooses into .claude/settings.json. Never replace that file or remove hooks already in it. Each top-level key under 'choices' is one hook; merge its 'hooks' entries into the matching event arrays.

danger-scan.what: Blocks catastrophic commands before they run and asks before risky ones.

memory-guard.what: Warns when the memory index grows past its size limit or an entry gets too long.

session-check.what: At the start of each session, flags folders without a CLAUDE.md, a big memory index and unprotected credential files.

bell.what: Rings the terminal bell when the agent finishes or needs an answer.
